channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran President Pezeshkian calls for unity as US ramps up economic pressure
item.description: Amid rising public discontent, Iranian authorities say adversaries are focused on encouraging domestic unrest.

item.title: At least four civilians killed in Houthi missile strike near Yemen’s Taiz
item.description: The attack on a crowded road comes amid fierce clashes across Taiz and Hodeidah and rapid civilian displacement.

item.title: Yemen government launches own air attacks on Houthis: What that means
item.description: A major Houthi offensive towards Bab al-Mandeb has triggered some of Yemen’s worst fighting in years.

item.title: Mudslide in eastern China kills one, leaves 11 missing
item.description: A mudslide triggered by days of heavy rain in Jiangxi province, China, has killed one person and left 11 missing.

item.title: At least 5 killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as US envoys visit Moscow
item.description: Ukraine and Russia announce a three-day limited ceasefire as US envoys visit Moscow, before trip to Kyiv.

item.title: Why is Trump threatening to strike Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain again, now?
item.description: As oil tanker struck off Kharg island, Trump threatens one of the remaining parts of Iran’s nuclear complex.

item.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
item.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

item.title: How could US-Iran conflict end? Three experts give their views
item.description: After renewed strikes this week, does either side have an exit strategy?

item.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
item.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.
